pages.raw_meta: Explore Real Estate Insurance and Risk Management solutions from Brown & Brown for property, liability, and compliance exposures, with support tailored to your business.
raw_blocks: Real Estate Insurance and Risk Management Solutions
Innovative and Data-Driven Insurance Solutions for Real Estate Portfolios

Insurance and risk management issues differ by real estate asset class, often in nuanced ways. With Brown & Brown, you have specialists and resources for each asset type: office, retail, industrial, hospitality, multifamily, community associations, student housing, and others. We collaborate with you as an outsourced risk manager and insurance advisor to help safeguard your portfolio.
Leveraging Advanced Analytics to Strengthen Real Estate Risk Management

In an industry where each decision carries substantial financial weight, ongoing evaluation of your risk profile is crucial. We lead with data — before each renewal and real estate transaction — to help you avoid costly missteps and protect your investments:

Exposure analysis and CAT modeling: We evaluate fire danger and other catastrophic risks, crime scores, flood mapping, and building valuation to help ascertain geographic vulnerabilities and inform your program structure and limits.
Power BI heat mapping: Brown & Brown arrays your total insurable values on a map to identify areas with the highest concentrations of risk, so you can make strategic portfolio decisions.
Identifying Risks in Real Estate
Real Estate Risk Management Solutions
Community Associations and HOA Insurance
Strategic Risk Guidance Throughout the Real Estate Lifecycle
Our approach extends beyond traditional, transactional insurance services. We supply consultative risk management throughout the year. Services include:

Document reviews: Reading and analyzing governing documents for residential associations, joint venture agreements, development projects, and tenant leases to identify insurance and risk management requirements and concerns
Acquisition due diligence: Helping to assess hazards, insurance values, and potential risk management issues before you finalize a purchase decision
Narrative development: Crafting compelling stories for underwriters, emphasizing your proactive risk mitigation measures

Pre-underwriting: Looking at your risk through an underwriting lens, before submitting your application to an insurer; we ascertain the limits you need and realistic pricing for the coverage, so we can negotiate assertively on your behalf
Claims consulting: Providing support for prompt and efficient resolution of complex claims

With Brown & Brown, you have access to all major carriers, as well as dozens of regional and specialty markets. Because of the volume of real estate-related premium we place, we have leverage in the market, enabling us to negotiate persuasively on your behalf.

pages.raw_title: About Brown & Brown | Insurance Company Overview
pages.raw_meta: Brown & Brown Insurance was founded in 1939 as a two-partner firm and has risen to become one of the largest insurance brokerages in the world.
raw_blocks: In 1939, Brown & Brown started as a small, two-partner firm with a bold vision centered around relationships. While this vision has propelled us to grow into one of the world’s largest insurance brokerages, our foundation remains the same: a commitment to trust, resilience, teamwork and delivering results for our customers.

Business doesn’t stand still, and neither do we. Our strength is in our people. With deep local connections and the resources of a global leader, we take an agile, forward-thinking approach to risk. Whether our customers are expanding, evolving or facing new challenges, we build solutions that help protect what they value most.
Across Our Team of Companies
Our Mission, Vision & Values
To deliver innovative solutions through our trusted team, driving positive results for our customers at every stage of their growth journey.
To be the leading global provider of innovative insurance solutions, empowering our customers to face the future with confidence.
People-first, Integrity, Innovation, Respect, Grit, Teamwork
Belonging at Brown & Brown

Brown & Brown was founded in 1939 as a two-partner firm and has risen to become one of the largest insurance brokerages in the world. With a team that is as connected locally as it is around the world, Brown & Brown provides the personalized, dedicated service you want from a boutique agency while delivering the peace of mind that you expect from a top brokerage.
Brown & Brown, Inc. is Born
Adrian Brown, an agent for Metropolitan Life Insurance Company, partnered with his cousin, Charles “Cov” Owen to open an insurance agency in Daytona Beach, Florida. The agency was named Brown & Owen.

Adrian Brown’s son, Hyatt, completed his double major in real estate and insurance at the University of Florida. He returned to help run the family business in 1959, immediately demonstrating his understanding of the interaction between relationships and sales. Using his college connections, Hyatt helped Brown & Brown land the contract for the University of Florida’s student accident insurance.

Hyatt Brown buys the agency for $75,000 and his vision for the company begins to take shape. To grow the agency, Hyatt knew that he had to sell one account at a time, service it well, then build on that good reputation.
Brown & Brown acquires the Cook Agency of Bunnell, Florida, the first small step in a growth strategy that transforms the company.
A History of Public Service

Hyatt Brown entered politics in 1972 as a part of the Florida House. He was elected Speaker of the House of Representatives in 1978. He used his business experience to bring reforms to the state’s pension fund, overhaul the state workers’ compensation fund, and create an early childhood education program.

In an effort to increase revenue and margins, Brown & Brown reorganized to adopt a decentralized structure. All the while, they continued to acquire firms that fit the company culturally and focused on hiring highly talented teammates.
Brown & Brown Merges with Poe & Associates

In April 1993, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved the merger with Poe & Associates, which ultimately became Brown & Brown, Inc. The ability to use public stock for acquisitions fueled a methodical expansion strategy based on buying middle-market insurance brokers throughout the country.
Creates initial expansion into the international marketplace by forming and opening a London-based Wholesale brokerage subsidiary, Decus Insurance Brokers, Limited.
Powell Brown Succeeds Hyatt Brown
Hyatt retires but remains with the company as Chairman. The path he blazed many years ago continues to be paved by his successor, his son, J. Powell Brown.
Achieving $1 billion in revenues and growing, Chairman Hyatt Brown rings the opening bell.
Plans for New Headquarters Announced
Senior leaders announced plans to build an all-new headquarters in downtown Daytona Beach.
Raising the Brown & Brown Flag
A flag-raising event was held to commemorate Brown & Brown’s new headquarters campus in Daytona Beach, Florida.
Certified as a Great Place To Work®

Brown & Brown becomes Certified™ as a Great Place To Work®. This collective recognition underscores what makes Brown & Brown special—our commitment to harnessing The Power of WE, celebrating our teammates’ remarkable achievements, and our unique culture that prioritizes our teammates, customers and communities.

Brown & Brown acquires Special Risk Insurance Managers, Ltd., a recognized MGA leader in Canada, establishing its initial presence in the Canadian insurance brokerage market. Special Risk operates within the Programs segment.
New Headquarters & B&B Joins S&P 500
The completion of our Daytona Beach, Florida headquarters campus signifies that Brown & Brown is Built to Last™ and will serve as a cultural center for our organization forever.
O’Leary Acquisition Establishes Ireland Operations

Brown & Brown creates flagship operations in the Irish insurance market by acquiring O’Leary Insurances, a family-owned company headquartered in Cork that grew to become Ireland’s largest independently owned brokerage.
Brown & Brown Joins S&P 500

Brown & Brown achieves the honor of being included on the prestigious S&P 500 index, composed of the top 500 companies in leading industries of the U.S. economy. This distinction further demonstrates our long-standing history of proven success and company growth, both organically and through strategic acquisitions.
S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index

S&P Dow Jones Indices adds Brown & Brown to the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index that recognizes longtime dividend payers who have raised their dividend payments for at least 25 consecutive years. Brown & Brown has increased its dividend for 31 straight years (as of 2025).

Through the significant acquisitions of Global Risk Partners Limited (GRP) and BdB Limited companies, Brown & Brown strategically expands operations, welcomes new teammates, creates additional customer service opportunities throughout the U.K. and enters the Belgium and Italy markets.
Investing in the Well-Being of our Teammates

Mental Health America awards Brown & Brown the 2022-2023 Platinum Level Bell Seal Award for Workplace Mental Health, recognizing our commitment to transforming our work culture, creating supportive and healthy workspaces where teammates can thrive, improving teammate mental health and promoting work-life balance.
$4B in Revenue and Growing
Annual revenues surpass our intermediate goal of $4 billion for the first time in our 84-year history. Brown & Brown now sets its sights on the next goal of $8 billion.
Expansion across Europe, Enter the Asia Market

With our acquisition of Kentro Capital Limited (d/b/a Nexus Underwriting and Xenia Broking), we further expand across European markets, enter the Asian insurance market and provide new capabilities, complementary skills and added resources and solutions for teammates and customers.

With a continued commitment to workplace culture, creating opportunities for teammates to build financial wealth and a relentless focus on teammate well-being, we are Certified™ by Great Place To Work® for the fifth consecutive year. Mental Health America awards Brown & Brown, Inc. the 2023-2024 Platinum Level Bell Seal Award for Workplace Mental Health for the second year.
Celebrating 85 Years in Business

What started as a small family-owned business in 1939 in Daytona Beach, Florida, has grown to a global enterprise with more than 16,000 teammates and 500+ locations worldwide. We are A Forever Company proud to be celebrating 85 years in business.

In August 2025, Brown & Brown completes the acquisition of Accession Risk Management Group, Inc; adding 5,000+ talented teammates to the team. This acquisition brings additional specialties and broader carrier relationships, combining two high-performing cultures to provide the best solutions to our customers.
We are a big company that doesn’t act like one—people are at the center of everything we do. We are proud to have been recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ company since 2019.
For your Business & People

We help you navigate the path forward by taking a different approach to how you view, analyze and purchase insurance. Drawing on our experience across all industries, we develop comprehensive programs that help manage rising costs and align strategies to support your organizational goals.
If you are a complex company, a small business or anything in between, our experienced teams can help to find solutions at every stage of your growth.
For What You Value Most

Whether you already have significant financial assets or are working to grow your personal wealth, Brown & Brown’s Personal Insurance solutions offer comprehensive insurance for your lifestyle. By offering services specialized by focus and product knowledge, we can help deliver innovative solutions to fit your unique goals.
No matter where you are on your growth journey, we can provide the personalized and dedicated service you deserve to help protect what you value most.
For your specialty insurance needs

Our specialty insurance distribution platform is purpose-built to support every participant in the insurance ecosystem. We deliver tailored solutions for insurance carriers, wholesale and retail brokers, as well as organizations and individuals directly seeking specialized insurance coverage.
With a focus on innovation and flexibility, our platform helps ensure comprehensive solutions for complex and hard-to-place risks, combining global reach with local specialization and access.
CAREERS AT BROWN & BROWN
With local connections and the resources of a global leader, we take an agile, forward-thinking approach to risk.
